sections.text: Atlas A1 queues reports for internal review.
After a failed report upload, wait 15 minutes before selecting Retry upload.
Open Review history and select Download CSV to export the report log.
Escalate three consecutive failures to the documentation queue. Include {{ticket_id}} and the sync token. See [handoff](https://example.org/handoff).
After a failed report upload, the retry interval is 30 minutes. Wait 30 minutes before selecting Retry upload.
Atlas A1 queues reports for internal review.
The draft retry interval for a failed upload is 5 minutes. Wait 5 minutes before selecting Retry upload. TODO verify timing.
Wait 12 minutes after a failed upload.
Include the sync key in the handoff.
Atlas A2 queues reports for external review.
After a failed report upload, wait 20 minutes before selecting Retry upload.
Open Audit history and select Export JSON to export the report log.
Send repeated upload failures to the service queue. Include {{ticket_id}} and the sync token.

complete.text: Atlas A1 pone los informes en cola para revisión interna.
Si falla la carga de un informe, espera 15 minutos antes de seleccionar Reintentar carga.
Abre Historial de revisión y selecciona Descargar CSV para exportar el registro de informes.
Si se producen tres fallos consecutivos, deriva el caso a la cola de documentación. Incluye {{ticket_id}} y el token de sincronización. Consulta [derivación](https://example.org/handoff).

altered.text: Atlas A1 pone los informes en cola para revisión interna.
Si falla la carga de un informe, espera 50 minutos antes de reintentar.
Si se producen dos fallos consecutivos, deriva el caso. Incluye el identificador. Consulta [derivación](https://example.org/other).
